vꜩih: utzij — its word; u- 'its' + tzij 'word', possessed noun
tacol: taqol — summoner, one who sends for; taq 'send' + -ol, agent ending
vlic: ulik — arrived here; ul 'arrive here' + -ik, ending at the end of a clause
pachcab: pachq'ab' — (guess) a guard for the hand; pach (not explained) + q'ab' 'hand'; Brasseur pachgab ('gants')
quum: kuum — (doubtful reading, guess) leather; written with a q-shaped letter, not the tz ligature; Brasseur reads tzuum 'leather', the tzuun 'leathers' of an earlier list; respelled by the letters
caztah: k'astaj — (inferred) come alive, revive; k'as 'live' (root of k'aslem 'life') + -taj 'become'; the restored k' is inferred from the known root
xi: xi — x- completive + i(n) 'me', the absolutive object, with the n not written (inferred); written apart before the ergative prefix and verb · xi — you (pl.) (did it); x- completive + i- 'you (pl.)', the ergative, before a transitive verb (xi b'ano 'you did it')
ꜭux: k'u'x — heart; noun (ki k'u'x 'their heart'); root of Uk'u'x
tao: tao — hear it; ta 'hear' + -o, the ending of a transitive verb (ka nu tao 'I hear it')
huzu: jusuk — suddenly, at once; adverb (Ximénez's huzu is huzuc with its c shared with the next word cu)
e: e — they; plural marker before a noun or verb · e — tooth, teeth; noun (also in we 'my teeth', re 'his teeth')
xebec: xeb'ek — they went; x- completive + e 'they' + b'e 'go' + -k (written c), the ending of an intransitive verb
ive: iwe — you (pl.); iw- 'your (pl.)' + e, the form seen in chiwe 'to you'
cute: k'ute — then, so; longer form of k'ut
retal: retal — its sign; r- 'its' + etal 'sign', possessed noun (xa retal 'only its sign')
xchi: xchi — shall; the future prefix xchi-, written apart before the person prefix and the verb
canah: kanaj — leave, stay behind; verb root (chin kanaj 'I leave off'; inferred)
ah: aj — he of, lord of, one who; agent/title prefix in names and occupations
camic: kamik — died, dying; cam 'die' + -ic (xoh camic 'we died')
mix: mix — has just; mi- 'just now' + x- completive
canahic: kanajik — remaining, shall remain; kanaj 'remain' + -ik (xa xchi canahic 'it shall only remain')
chicu: chik'u — now then, again then; chik 'now, again' + k'u 'then' written as one word
rax: rax — green, raw, fresh; also 'sudden' (rax kamik 'green death', Brasseur 'mort subite')
vleu: ulew — earth, land; noun; u- here part of the word, not 'its'
chaquih: chaqi'j — dry; adjective · chaqi'j — (inferred) dry (something), parch; used as a verb in xqui chaquih 'they dried it' over the fire (Brasseur 'jeté sur le feu') · chaqi'j — (guess) spend (the day) at something; in qui chaquih chi hutaquih, after Brasseur 'ils employaient tout le jour'
vpa: upa — its belly, its inside; u- 'its' + pa 'belly, inside', possessed noun
